title: Fail-closed native Code Owner review enforcement and promotion guard

evidence: .github/CODEOWNERS requests @Goldkelch but does not enforce approval
.github/workflows/qikvrt_expected_head_promotion.yml previously had no live review/ruleset precondition before merge

implementation.review_gate: An unprivileged PR/review-event observer contains no repository access or write permission. A trusted-main workflow_run/scheduled publisher then reobserves the current PR head, current main rules, and current reviews, posts only an exact-head status, and never creates, approves, dismisses, or impersonates a review.
implementation.native_rule: The evaluator accepts success only when GitHub itself requires one approval, Code Owner review, stale-review dismissal, and last-push approval.
implementation.promotion_guard: Expected-head promotion blocks without a fresh exact-head successful gate observation and reobserves it immediately before its merge endpoint.
implementation.untrusted_pr_boundary: The observer has permissions: {} and no checkout. The status-writing publisher runs only from main, checks out ref main, consumes no observer output, and never executes a PR head.

required_platform_completion.later_after_gate_observation: Add status context QIKVRT required code-owner review as a required main check.
required_platform_completion.boundary: Only an administrator with an explicit platform authorization may mutate this GitHub ruleset.
